title: How your Express Pass works
body: One Express ride per attraction per day, at all three parks, and it resets every morning. Scan the paper pass or the QR code in the Universal app at each ride's Express entrance. It does not work at Hagrid's, Pteranodon Flyers or Dragon Racer's Rally. Mark each Express ride as used in the Now tab and the suggestions will stop counting on it.

title: Rider Switch
body: When someone sits a ride out, tell the attendant at the entrance. The non-rider waits in the family room with the first group, then the second adult rides without lining up again. It works with Express.

title: Height checks
body: The youngest clears every ride except the Incredible Hulk Coaster (54") and Doctor Doom's Fearfall (52"). VelociCoaster is 51", so she clears it by half an inch with shoes on. Heights are measured at the entrance.

title: Lockers and metal detectors
body: Lockers are free for the posted wait plus ride time, then $3 per 30 minutes. Hulk, VelociCoaster and Stardust Racers have metal detectors: nothing in pockets at all, phones included. Gringotts, the Mummy, Men in Black, Forbidden Journey, Hagrid's, Monsters Unchained and Hiccup's also require a locker. Epic's lockers open with face scan, set up when you enter.

title: Getting around
body: Cabana Bay to CityWalk: 15–25 min walk or a shuttle every ~15 min. CityWalk to Islands: about 2 min; to Studios: about 7 min. Epic has its own shuttle from Cabana Bay (15–25 min). Hopping between Epic and Studios/Islands is a bus via CityWalk: budget 45–60 minutes.

title: Early entry
body: Cabana Bay guests get an hour early at Islands of Adventure (8am) and Epic Universe (9am Thursday, 8am Saturday). Not at Studios. Tickets are checked at entry, and guests are let in about 15 minutes before early entry starts.

title: Studios closes at 5pm
body: Halloween Horror Nights runs every night of the trip, so Universal Studios closes to day guests at 5pm. Horror Nights isn't recommended for kids under 13. Islands and Epic stay open until 8pm.

title: Closed or changed
body: Jurassic Park River Adventure is closed for refurbishment through Nov 19. Skull Island: Reign of Kong is running without its King Kong finale. Po Live!, the Horror Make-Up Show and Finnegan's are closed. Fast & Furious and Rip Ride Rockit are gone for good. The parade isn't expected to run.

title: Mobile food ordering
body: In the Universal app you can order food once you're inside the park, then tap "Prepare my food" when you're close. No upcharge. Availability changes, so check the app per restaurant.

title: Prices to expect
body: Power-Up Bands $45 each (link each one in the Universal app). Interactive wands $85 ($65 first-generation; engraving $30). The 10-year-olds pay adult prices at restaurants; kids' menus are for ages 9 and under.

title: Single rider lines
body: Good for anyone willing to ride alone: Gringotts, Men in Black, the Mummy, Transformers, Spider-Man, Hulk, Forbidden Journey, VelociCoaster, and most of Epic's big rides. Parents and young kids can't ride together from a single rider line.
